name: Navigation
author: Brett
description: Molly's navigation menu: each app (Console, axHub, AmberX and any app added later) opens a sub menu with that app's own pages that slides open; its own settings interface for the theme, colours, fonts, icons, density, width, animation, behaviour and the order of the apps (nav-style@1, hot-swappable presets, live preview, reset).

items.title: Read the navigation settings
items.description: Every nav-style field in force (the preset with the changes on top). Same values as control@1: axf token nav list.

items.title: Change one navigation setting
items.description: Set one nav-style field, e.g. animation.kind push. Same as axf token nav set <path> <value>.

items.title: Reset the navigation settings
items.description: Drops every change, back to the preset.

items.title: Pick a navigation preset
items.description: Hot-swaps the nav-style asset (standard, glide, accordion, soft-fade, push, still).

items.title: Open a navigation item
items.description: Opens a page: an app (console) or one of its pages (console/nav:builds), inside the app's frame, and slides its sub menu open.

commands.noReads: no data folder: the settings are look settings on axHub (axf.tokens.nav) and per-device state
